_comment: CANONICAL syndication rate data — the ONLY home for these numbers. Edit here; the TS engine (src/lib/syndication-pricing.ts) and the rate card (tools/syndication-rate-card.mjs) both read this. Never hardcode a syndication rate anywhere else. status: confirmed = an outlet agreed; proposed = standard ask.
rules: Never sell exclusive to two outlets in overlapping markets — first rights to one, reprint to the rest.
Only bill for my own photos. Others' shots travel courtesy + credit, $0.
Disclose where a version ran ('also appears in the Anniston Star') on my own sites, not in a competitor's copy.
Money-gate: confirm each outlet's actual rate before quoting; never state a rate as fact until they agree.
A $75 reel sold ≈ break-even against $75 production (Ginna). Bundle or mark up.
